## Summary of the Problem

The reason `gem install bundler` was trying to access Ruby 2.6 is because:

1. **rbenv was not initialized** in your shell session
2. Your shell was using the system Ruby (2.6.10) instead of the rbenv-managed Ruby (2.7.8)
3. The rbenv Ruby 2.7.8 installation has architecture compatibility issues (likely compiled for Intel, but you're on Apple Silicon)

## Solutions

You have a few options to fix this:
